name: OmniCorp Sentry Sweep
description: Triggered when noise or cyberware signatures exceed security threshold in Sector 09.

steps.title: Threat Vector Detected
steps.text: Warning klaxons echo through the damp concrete alley as scarlet searchlights snap directly onto your visor. Heavy boots rhythmically crunch broken glass—an OmniCorp tactical strike team has locked onto your neural signature!

choices.text: Take tactical cover behind ferroconcrete pillars and engage

outcome.logMessage: You draw weapons and engage the OmniCorp patrol team!

choices.text: Overload nearby power conduit with EtherTech discharge [EtherTech DC 13]

check.passText: You discharge an ether wave into the high-voltage breaker, blinding their optical suites and escaping!
check.failText: The breaker sparks harmlessly; the enforcers advance on your position!

actionResolution.title: Conduit Overload
actionResolution.resultText: You unleash an ether arc into the high-voltage breaker, blinding the enforcers and shorting their optical suites! You slip away into the shadows with salvaged parts.

choices.text: Attempt emergency retreat through drainage shafts [Body DC 11]

outcome.logMessage: You sprint through the drainage tunnels back to your fortified hideout!

name: Shady Tech Courier
description: A nervous cyber-courier with an encrypted datapad seeking a discreet buyer.

steps.title: Nervous Encrypted Drop
steps.text: A hooded courier wearing a cracked neuro-mask grabs your sleeve in the alley. 'Hey—you got the look of a runner. OmniCorp hounds are three blocks back. Buy this encrypted vault-key drive off me for 100 credits, or I dump it in the acid canal.'

choices.text: [Buy Drive - 100 Credits] Hand over the currency
[Presence DC 12] Intimidate him into giving up the drive

check.passText: The courier recoils in panic, drops the drive, and bolts into the steam vents.
check.failText: The courier scoffs, smashes the drive against the wall, and escapes into the crowd.

choices.text: Walk away and ignore the runner

steps.text: The courier nods frantically, pockets the cred-chips, and tosses you the drive before disappearing down a service shaft. You now have an encrypted neural jack.
The courier surrenders the hardware under your menacing gaze. You inspect the salvaged sub-grid components.
You decline to get involved in someone else's death wish and continue down the rain-slicked boulevard.
